SCOPE, VOLUME & IMPLEMENTATION

Built around
your operating model.

Platform subscription. Annual contracts cover the agreed software scope, users, and API allowance. Additional users, environments, and API volume are quoted separately.

*Payment volume. Proposed usage pricing above included volume: 5 basis points for Treasury and 2 basis points for Institutional. These are Numina platform fees only. Network fees, FX, liquidity-provider spreads, custody, and payout charges are separate and corridor-dependent.

Implementation. Indicative one-time onboarding starts at $10,000 for Treasury and $35,000 for Institutional. Final scope depends on systems, controls, and integrations.

Service terms. Support coverage, retention, deployment requirements, and any SLA are negotiated. No uptime certification, custody service, regulated status, or execution venue is implied.

Before we get started.

Can I use this for real trading or payments today?

The terminal on this site is an interactive prototype with simulated data and actions. Production requires connected market data, payment and custody partners, security review, and the relevant operational and regulatory arrangements.

How were these plans structured?

The model combines annual platform fees, seats, usage allowances, implementation, and negotiated enterprise terms. Published infrastructure pricing from Fireblocks ↗ provides a market reference for subscription-plus-volume packaging. Numina's proposed prices and features are its own; the services are not represented as equivalent.

Are market data and execution fees included?

No. Exchange entitlements, premium datasets, brokerage fees, custody, network fees, FX spreads, and third-party execution costs are scoped separately. There is no performance fee in these proposed tiers.

Can we start with a design partnership?

Yes. Contact Sam to discuss the workflow, integration requirements, and acceptance criteria for a scoped pilot. Pricing and deliverables would be agreed before any work or payment commitment.
